content.value_statement: Office work often requires repeated formatting, conversion, reporting, and presentation tasks. This skill provides a structured workflow for creating and reviewing office files.
actual_capabilities: Lists workflow phases for document creation, spreadsheet automation, presentation generation, conversion, graphics, and database reports.
Points users to related office skills for LibreOffice, Microsoft Office, Google Sheets, diagrams, and file organization.
Provides copy-paste prompts for choosing document, spreadsheet, presentation, and conversion workflows.
Defines quality gates for formatting, formulas, presentations, conversions, automation, and file organization.
Maps common office formats, including ODT, ODS, ODP, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, and Google Workspace formats.
limitations: It is a workflow guide, not an executable automation script.
It depends on separate office skills or tools to create actual files.
It does not validate document content, formulas, or presentation design by itself.
It does not include custom templates, sample data, or brand style rules.

use_cases.title: Build Recurring Reports
use_cases.description: Coordinate documents, spreadsheets, charts, and exports for weekly or monthly reporting packages.

use_cases.title: Prepare Spreadsheet Outputs
use_cases.description: Plan spreadsheet structures, formulas, charts, and export steps before creating an Excel or LibreOffice report.

use_cases.title: Convert and Organize Files
use_cases.description: Choose conversion and file organization steps for office documents moving between common formats.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Document Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a simple office deliverable.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a simple office workflow for [goal]. Include needed document types, spreadsheet steps, presentation steps, and final quality checks.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Report Package
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for recurring business reports.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a report package for [audience]. Include source data, spreadsheet work, document sections, charts, export formats, and review gates.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Multi-Format Delivery
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for mixed office formats.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a workflow that produces [formats] from [inputs]. Include specialist skills, conversion steps, verification checks, and file organization.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an Automation Pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of an existing office workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this office workflow: [steps]. Identify missing tools, format risks, quality gates, conversion checks, and distribution concerns.

output_examples.input: Create a quarterly sales report package.
output_examples.output: A workflow covering spreadsheet data import, chart generation, written summary sections, slide creation, PDF export, and quality checks.

output_examples.input: Convert legacy office files for a client archive.
output_examples.output: A conversion plan that identifies source formats, target formats, verification steps, batch handling, and file organization tasks.

output_examples.input: Prepare a presentation from dashboard metrics.
output_examples.output: A slide workflow with template selection, chart placement, speaker notes, export formats, and review gates.

best_practices: Start with the final format requirements before selecting supporting tools.
Verify formulas, charts, and exported files before distributing office deliverables.
Use separate specialist skills for file creation, conversion, and design details.
anti_patterns: Do not treat this workflow guide as a replacement for document validation.
Do not skip quality gates after conversion or mail merge steps.
Do not use unrelated skills when a narrower office skill is available.

faq.question: Does this skill create Office files directly?
faq.answer: No. It guides the workflow and points to specialist skills that create or convert files.

faq.question: Which formats does it mention?
faq.answer: It covers LibreOffice formats, Microsoft Office formats, Google Workspace formats, and PDF-focused workflows.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: No evidence of required network access was found in the reviewed Markdown file.

faq.question: Is it suitable for batch conversion planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes conversion phases, verification checks, and file organization steps.

faq.question: What should I provide in my prompt?
faq.answer: Provide the goal, source files, target formats, required tools, and quality checks.
